title: The Baker Who Lied
style: cinematic live-action film still, 35mm, shallow depth of field, cool noir grade, realistic skin, vertical 9:16

maya.look: Maya, a woman in her early 30s with a sleek dark bob haircut, sharp green eyes, wearing a flour-dusted apron over a black blouse

leo.look: Leo, a 12-year-old boy with messy brown hair and a school backpack

viper.look: Viktor Crane, a polished man in his 50s in an expensive grey suit with silver hair and a cold smile

scenes.image: [[maya]] kneading dough in a cozy small-town bakery at 5 AM, warm glowing light
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: By day, Maya sold bread. By night, she was somebody else entirely.

scenes.image: [[leo]] at the bakery counter eating a croissant, smiling up at [[maya]]
scenes.speaker: leo
scenes.line: Sis, you smell like flour and secrets.

scenes.image: [[maya]] laughing but her eyes flick to a black car parked across the street
scenes.motion: slow rack focus from her face to the car
scenes.speaker: maya
scenes.line: Eat your breakfast, Leo. And go straight to school.

scenes.image: Back room of the bakery, [[maya]] opens a hidden panel behind flour sacks revealing a pistol and an earpiece, dim light
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Two years undercover. One mission. Bring down the smuggling king of the city.

scenes.image: Luxury restaurant at night, [[viper]] across a candlelit table from [[maya]] in a red dress, tense
scenes.speaker: viper
scenes.line: You are very good at lying, Miss Hart. Almost as good as I am.

scenes.image: Close-up of [[maya]] hiding fear behind a perfect smile, her hand trembling under the table
scenes.speaker: maya
scenes.line: I do not know what you mean, Mr. Crane.

scenes.image: [[viper]] slides a photo of [[leo]] across the table, candlelight reflecting in his eyes
scenes.motion: the photo slides into frame, camera pushes in
scenes.speaker: viper
scenes.line: Then you will not mind if my men walk your brother home.

scenes.image: Extreme close-up of [[maya]]'s eyes, a single tear and a determined look, blurred restaurant behind
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: The mission was never about the mafia. It just became personal. Part two... tomorrow.

caption: She protects the city. Who protects her brother? #drama #spy #story
next_hook: Will Maya save Leo without blowing her cover?
